vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-126190
vulnerability.description: Soup Sieve versions before 4.0.0 can exhibit polynomial-time denial of service while matching descendant combinators against deeply nested attacker-influenced HTML or XML.

statements.status_notes: The aedt and all extras include JupyterLab, which brings in SoupSieve transitively. The lock resolves SoupSieve 2.10 for Python versions below 3.11.5; that version is within the advisory's affected range. Reachability of the vulnerable behavior in product use has not yet been assessed.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-126190
vulnerability.description: Soup Sieve versions before 4.0.0 can exhibit polynomial-time denial of service while matching descendant combinators against deeply nested attacker-influenced HTML or XML.

statements.status_notes: For Python 3.11.5 and later, the lock resolves SoupSieve 4.1, which is beyond the first patched version 4.0.0.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-126192
vulnerability.description: Soup Sieve versions before 2.10 can perform excessive work for certain :has() selectors containing the general sibling combinator.

statements.status_notes: The recorded lock resolutions are SoupSieve 2.10 for Python below 3.11.5 and 4.1 from Python 3.11.5 onward. Both are at or above the first patched version 2.10.
